name: Job Offer Total Compensation Calculator
description: Normalize salary, bonus, equity, retirement contributions and recurring benefits into estimated annual total compensation.
search_intent: Compare job offers by annualizing salary, bonus, equity and employer-paid compensation.
calculation: Annualized equity = total stated equity grant value ÷ vesting years. Recurring annual compensation = salary + target bonus + annualized equity + employer retirement contribution + annual benefits. First-year compensation = recurring annual compensation + signing bonus. Monthly equivalent = recurring annual compensation ÷ 12. Base salary share = salary ÷ recurring compensation × 100 when recurring compensation is positive.
limitations: Equity value is uncertain and may change substantially.
Taxes, vesting cliffs, refresh grants and benefit quality are not fully modeled.
Target bonuses may not be guaranteed.
